props.name: rejectLabel
props.description: Label for the reject button. Defaults to "Reject".

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Label for the skip button. Defaults to "Skip".

props.name: whenDone
props.description: Hide the empty state while items remain. Defaults to true.

props.name: children
props.description: Render custom copy. Receives the number of items still to review.

props.name: roles
props.description: Roles to administer. The first part holds the name, member count, and a System badge for built-in roles.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Permissions offered in the detail checklist. Adjacent items sharing `group` render under one section header.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Id of the role selected on first render. Falls back to the first role.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the full role set whenever a role is added, duplicated, deleted, or its permissions change.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled list of flags.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial list of flags.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next list whenever a flag is toggled.

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
Key that opens the cheat sheet from anywhere. Pass null to disable
the global hotkey.

props.name: title
props.type: string | (string & React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>>) | (string & Iterable<React.ReactNode>) | (string & React.ReactPortal) | (string & Promise<AwaitedReactNode>)

props.name: heading
props.description: Group heading shown above its shortcut rows.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keys in the combo, each rendered as a KbdDisplay inside a KbdGroup.

props.name: step
props.description: The active step index, 0-based. Pass with `onStepChange` to control.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The initial step index for the uncontrolled case, 0-based.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called when the active step changes, with the next 0-based index.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when the last step is finished.

props.name: variant
props.description: Render a continuous bar instead of one dot per step.

props.name: value
props.description: This step's index, 0-based. Renders only while it is the active step.

props.name: showSkip
props.description: Show the Skip button on non-final steps.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Label for the advance button on the last step.

props.name: items
props.description: Crumbs to render. The last item becomes the current page.

props.name: path
props.description: A URL path to derive crumbs from when `items` is omitted.

props.name: basePath
props.description: Prefix prepended to each `href` generated from `path`.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse the middle into an ellipsis when the trail exceeds this.

props.name: showHome
props.description: Prepend a Home crumb linking to `homeHref`.

props.name: homeHref
props.description: Destination for the leading Home crumb.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Render as the current page (non-link) instead of a link.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default query text when uncontrolled.

props.name: scopes
props.description: The selectable search scopes shown in the leading dropdown.

props.name: scope
props.description: The active scope value (controlled).

props.name: defaultScope
props.description: Default scope value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onScopeChange
props.description: Called when the active scope changes.

props.name: value
props.description: The query text (controlled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the query text changes.

props.name: tokens
props.description: The active filter tokens, each `key:value` (controlled).

props.name: defaultTokens
props.description: Default filter tokens when uncontrolled.

props.name: onTokensChange
props.description: Called when the active filter tokens change.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown in the text input.

props.name: icon
props.description: Render the leading search icon.

props.name: filters
props.description: Render the trailing filters button.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the token in the active filter list.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading shown above the group.

props.name: live
props.description: Mark the group as live results, adding the active-state indicator.

props.name: value
props.description: Inserted as the query, or added as a token when it reads `key:value`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Run instead of the default insert/add when this suggestion is chosen.

props.name: entries

props.name: version

props.name: date
props.description: Release date, rendered as a `time` element.

props.name: latest
props.description: Marks this as the newest release with a live accent-cool marker.

props.name: type
props.description: Change category. Sets the tag Badge label, icon, and token shade.
